visual_style: 16-bit-inspired, crisp pixel edges, limited palette, readable silhouettes

research_basis.physical_map: Natural Earth 10m physical vectors: land, ocean, coastline, rivers/lakes, reefs, bathymetry and glaciated areas.
research_basis.historical_climate: NOAA NCEI climate reconstructions include temperature, precipitation, vegetation and related variables.
research_basis.biodiversity: GBIF provides species occurrence APIs and downloads; use as ecological evidence rather than direct population density.
research_basis.biomes: WWF Terrestrial Ecoregions: 867 terrestrial ecoregions across 14 biomes.

asset_rules: No gradients in core UI assets
Icons are overlays/markers, not replacements for simulation data
